acceptance: A fixture repo with a `fixup!` commit since the last tag fails release-preflight naming it (red: preflight passes)
--require-ci with no visible CI run fails; without it the CI check stays advisory
skills/release/SKILL.md calls the preflight instead of gh and git log
fix: Add a no-WIP step to release-preflight: subjects since the last tag that match the skill's pattern refuse with the list, exit 1. Add `--require-ci`, which turns an unavailable CI verdict into a failure. Then drop the skill's gh and git steps in favour of `evolve release-preflight <v> --require-ci`. Document both in runtime-reference.md's release lifecycle.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: release-preflight already hard-gates the release commit's required CI run (gateReleaseCommitCI, internal/releasepreflight/preflight_run.go:319), but it skips that gate as advisory when gh shows no run. /evo:release still runs its own `gh run list` CI step and a `git log <last tag>..HEAD` scan for WIP, fixup!, squash! and amend! subjects (skills/release/SKILL.md:31-38), because the preflight has no WIP scan and cannot fail on a CI verdict it could not see.
title: `evolve release-preflight` lacks the no-WIP-commit check that the /evo:release skill runs with git log; add it to the preflight
